tables: table:agent_profiles:CREATE TABLE agent_profiles ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('claude', 'codex', 'grok')), PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id) )

table:audit_events:CREATE TABLE audit_events ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, audit_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_principal_id TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, audit_id), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id) )

table:comments:CREATE TABLE comments ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, author_human_id TEXT, author_delegation_id TEXT, body TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('discussion', 'progress')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, task_id) REFERENCES tasks (workspace_id, id) )

table:human_credentials:CREATE TABLE human_credentials ( human_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, algorithm TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scrypt', updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (human_id) REFERENCES humans (id) )

table:human_sessions:CREATE TABLE human_sessions ( session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, human_id TEXT NOT NULL, workspace_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (human_id) REFERENCES humans (id) )
table:humans:CREATE TABLE humans ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, display_name TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL )

table:idempotency_records:CREATE TABLE idempotency_records ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, command_name TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, idempotency_key), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id) )

table:oauth_access_tokens:CREATE TABLE oauth_access_tokens ( token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, delegation_id TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, delegation_id) REFERENCES oauth_delegations (workspace_id, id) )

table:oauth_delegations:CREATE TABLE oauth_delegations ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, human_id TEXT NOT NULL, client_id TEXT NOT NULL, resource TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT, task_id TEXT, scopes_json TEXT NOT NULL, authorization_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id), FOREIGN KEY (human_id) REFERENCES humans (id) )

table:outbox_records:CREATE TABLE outbox_records ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, outbox_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, delivered_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, outbox_id), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id) )

table:passkey_step_up_proofs:CREATE TABLE passkey_step_up_proofs ( proof_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, human_id TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, client_id TEXT, resource TEXT, boundary_json TEXT NOT NULL, scopes_json TEXT NOT NULL, authorization_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, consumed_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (human_id) REFERENCES humans (id) )

table:preregistered_oauth_clients:CREATE TABLE preregistered_oauth_clients ( client_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, redirect_uri TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, public_client INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 )

table:project_access:CREATE TABLE project_access ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, human_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, project_id, human_id), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects (workspace_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, human_id) REFERENCES workspace_members (workspace_id, human_id) )

table:project_policies:CREATE TABLE project_policies ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, allow_agent_root_propose INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, allow_pass_to_agent INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, resource_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, project_id), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects (workspace_id, id) )

table:projects:CREATE TABLE projects ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, slug TEXT NOT NULL, tint TEXT NOT NULL, resource_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, id), UNIQUE (workspace_id, slug), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id) )
table:rate_limit_buckets:CREATE TABLE rate_limit_buckets ( bucket_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, window_started_at TEXT NOT NULL, count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (count >= 0), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL )
table:schema_migration_state:CREATE TABLE schema_migration_state ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), status TEXT NOT NULL, current_migration_id TEXT, detail TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL )
table:schema_migrations:CREATE TABLE schema_migrations ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL )

table:semantic_events:CREATE TABLE semantic_events ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT NOT NULL, workspace_cursor INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, event_id), UNIQUE (workspace_id, workspace_cursor), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id) )

table:task_context_items:CREATE TABLE task_context_items ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, task_id TEXT NOT NULL, audience TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (audience IN ('human', 'agent', 'both')), body TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, task_id) REFERENCES tasks (workspace_id, id) )

table:tasks:CREATE TABLE tasks ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('proposed', 'ready', 'in_progress', 'blocked', 'done', 'cancelled')), priority TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (priority IN ('P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3')), due_at TEXT, next_owner_type TEXT CHECK (next_owner_type IN ('human', 'agent_profile', 'unassigned')), next_owner_id TEXT, next_action_reason TEXT, punchline TEXT NOT NULL, resource_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_by_human_id TEXT, created_by_delegation_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects (workspace_id, id) )

table:tenant_fixture_children:CREATE TABLE tenant_fixture_children ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_id TEXT NOT NULL, label TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, parent_id) REFERENCES tenant_fixture_items (workspace_id, id) )

table:tenant_fixture_items:CREATE TABLE tenant_fixture_items ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, label TEXT NOT NULL, resource_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (resource_version >= 1), PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id) )
table:workspace_cursors:CREATE TABLE workspace_cursors ( workspace_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, cursor INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (cursor >= 0), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id) )

table:workspace_members:CREATE TABLE workspace_members ( workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, human_id TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('owner', 'member', 'restricted_member')), authorization_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (workspace_id, human_id), FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id), FOREIGN KEY (human_id) REFERENCES humans (id) )

table:workspaces:CREATE TABLE workspaces ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK (length(id) = 26), slug TEXT NOT NULL, jurisdiction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (jurisdiction IN ('eu', 'us', 'global')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, resource_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (resource_version >= 1), UNIQUE (slug) )
